question: The ART (Regulation) Act 2021 and the Surrogacy (Regulation) Act 2021 are the same legislation and govern the same procedures.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Incorrect. ART Act 2021 governs ART clinics, banks, and assisted reproductive procedures (IVF, IUI, donor gametes). Surrogacy Act 2021 governs surrogacy arrangements specifically. Both were enacted in 2021 but are distinct Acts addressing different though related areas of reproductive medicine.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this is false. These are two distinct Acts passed in the same parliamentary session but governing different procedures. The ART Act 2021 regulates ART clinics and banks, donor practices, and assisted reproductive technologies (IVF, IUI, etc.). The Surrogacy Act 2021 specifically governs gestational surrogacy arrangements. They interact but are separate statutes with separate regulatory frameworks.
